key_insight: TRACE supports memory-efficient time series class-incremental learning by preserving class knowledge in lightweight generative models rather than stored examples.
engineering_relevance: For evolving sensing applications with tight memory and data-retention constraints, TRACE offers a replay-free approach to recognizing new and previously learned classes.
method: Extract features with a compact, frozen temporal-spectral representation.
Train and retain independent, lightweight class-specific autoencoders.
Classify using reconstruction-based scores without historical samples or large statistical matrices.
evidence_signal: Across five TSCIL benchmarks, TRACE reports competitive accuracy, approximately 98.26% lower mean retained memory than TS-ACL, and approximately 33.43% relative accuracy improvement on GrabMyo.
watch_item: Retaining one autoencoder per class may increase storage and reconstruction-scoring cost as the number of classes grows.
paper_title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
